title: Saggar Pit Firing with Keons
summary: Participate in a pit barrel saggar firing led by ceramic artist Keons Sekera where pots are wrapped with minerals and natural materials, placed in a pit, and fired overnight.
source_quote:
Saggar Pit Firing with Keons
During July, we were lucky to have ceramic artist Keons Sekera lead us in the ancient process of pit firing.
evidence_sentence: A blog post describes pit firing workshops where pots are wrapped in saggars with oxides, carbonates, and natural materials, then fired in a pit overnight.
evidence_quote: That package is then wrapped in a further layer of clay and placed in a pit. A fire is then built around the pots and allowed to burn overnight. We will be doing this again in August, and would love you join us.
